F01.rationale: Solve with editable status/priority/claim configuration or a preset, not a film-specific domain mode. Account for terminal column and claim behavior.
semantic_critical_checks: Solve with editable status/priority/claim configuration or a preset, not a film-specific domain mode.
Account for terminal column and claim behavior.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Do not require a separate binary or coding-agent usage.

F02.rationale: Support the bounded usability need or shared search behavior; do not demand proof of another workflow or propose AI search. Retain readable matches and ID lookup; do not claim the TUI behavior was independently verified.
semantic_critical_checks: Support the bounded usability need or shared search behavior; do not demand proof of another workflow or propose AI search.
Retain readable matches and ID lookup; do not claim the TUI behavior was independently verified.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Mention verification of actual TUI behavior and shared matching semantics.

F03.rationale: Preserve separate occurrence records and missed work rather than recycling one task. Use explicit catch-up invocation or another bounded local trigger; no mandatory always-on service. If defer, identify a real schedule/occurrence ambiguity with a concrete resolving decision, not a blanket automation ban.
semantic_critical_checks: Preserve separate occurrence records and missed work rather than recycling one task.
Use explicit catch-up invocation or another bounded local trigger; no mandatory always-on service.
If defer, identify a real schedule/occurrence ambiguity with a concrete resolving decision, not a blanket automation ban.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Address idempotence, holiday skips and bounded generation.

F04.rationale: Keep source boards authoritative and include board identity with task ID. Preserve read-only scope and report missing directories distinctly.
semantic_critical_checks: Keep source boards authoritative and include board identity with task ID.
Preserve read-only scope and report missing directories distinctly.

F05.rationale: Treat metadata preservation as new capability, not already supported. Preserve nested values through ordinary edits without adding accession/storage as first-class concepts. Allow a namespace only with a plan for legacy unnamespaced files; no silent dropping.
semantic_critical_checks: Treat metadata preservation as new capability, not already supported.
Preserve nested values through ordinary edits without adding accession/storage as first-class concepts.
Allow a namespace only with a plan for legacy unnamespaced files; no silent dropping.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Separate semantic-value preservation from YAML comments/style; no automatic need for query/rule framework.

F06.rationale: Offer a bounded one-way calendar export/file without mandatory service or two-way sync. Keep private notes/contact data out and maintain stable identity for updates.
semantic_critical_checks: Offer a bounded one-way calendar export/file without mandatory service or two-way sync.
Keep private notes/contact data out and maintain stable identity for updates.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: State date-only semantics and completion treatment need definition.

F07.rationale: Use/inspect existing narrow layout and title settings before inventing a new phone mode. Keep same board usable on large monitors; no dedicated task schema or native app.
semantic_critical_checks: Use/inspect existing narrow layout and title settings before inventing a new phone mode.
Keep same board usable on large monitors; no dedicated task schema or native app.

F08.rationale: Recognize existing missing-is-satisfied behavior; retain it for unconfigured boards through explicit policy/migration. Use consistent eligibility and pick behavior and distinguish missing from unfinished.
semantic_critical_checks: Recognize existing missing-is-satisfied behavior; retain it for unconfigured boards through explicit policy/migration.
Use consistent eligibility and pick behavior and distinguish missing from unfinished.

F09.rationale: Place agent process/worktree/spending/stall supervision outside the core board rather than accept whole request as a mere optional feature. Offer an orchestrator using board contracts; do not promise exactly-once dispatch from cooperative claims.
semantic_critical_checks: Place agent process/worktree/spending/stall supervision outside the core board rather than accept whole request as a mere optional feature.
Offer an orchestrator using board contracts; do not promise exactly-once dispatch from cooperative claims.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Preserve human-decision stops and tool choice.

F10.rationale: Do not promise automatic correct identity reconciliation where conflicts/references are ambiguous. Propose reviewable mapping/repair preserving both notes and explicitly handle ambiguous structured and prose references. Do not claim local claims prevent duplicate disconnected work.
semantic_critical_checks: Do not promise automatic correct identity reconciliation where conflicts/references are ambiguous.
Propose reviewable mapping/repair preserving both notes and explicitly handle ambiguous structured and prose references.
Do not claim local claims prevent duplicate disconnected work.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Mention current automatic repair and need to inspect/preserve evidence before any repair; policy for stale claims.

F11.rationale: Offer repeatable bounded report/export without mandatory custom script, terminal, or live portal. Omit task bodies and respect configured statuses.
semantic_critical_checks: Offer repeatable bounded report/export without mandatory custom script, terminal, or live portal.
Omit task bodies and respect configured statuses.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Stable generation date, long titles, completion date filters.

F12.rationale: Do not automatically accept unconditional parent transitions or overwrite independent parent decisions. Resolve direct-child/descendant and archived semantics before implementation. Allow explicit per-parent automation in principle; no blanket no-automation rule.
semantic_critical_checks: Do not automatically accept unconditional parent transitions or overwrite independent parent decisions.
Resolve direct-child/descendant and archived semantics before implementation.
Allow explicit per-parent automation in principle; no blanket no-automation rule.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Explain transition provenance, reopen policy and idempotence.

F13.rationale: Optional adapter with explicit linking and field ownership, offline local usability, preview and conflicts. No hidden unconditional last-writer-wins or publishing local-only notes. A defer decision must identify a specific unresolved sync contract, not reject all integrations.
semantic_critical_checks: Optional adapter with explicit linking and field ownership, offline local usability, preview and conflicts.
No hidden unconditional last-writer-wins or publishing local-only notes.
A defer decision must identify a specific unresolved sync contract, not reject all integrations.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Distinguish authentication availability from authorization to publish.

F14.rationale: Do not add repair-shop-specific mandatory fields or constraints for all tasks/old boards. If implemented, shared configurable validation covers both interfaces, preserves old state on failure, and makes exceptions explicit. Do not promise direct file editing is secured; do not leap to a full rules language without comparing narrower options.
semantic_critical_checks: Do not add repair-shop-specific mandatory fields or constraints for all tasks/old boards.
If implemented, shared configurable validation covers both interfaces, preserves old state on failure, and makes exceptions explicit.
Do not promise direct file editing is secured; do not leap to a full rules language without comparing narrower options.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Clarify where test note/inspector are represented; account for tags and existing completed work.

F15.rationale: Recognize exact manual sequence needs stored user intent; existing due/priority sort alone does not solve it. Reject implicit display-to-pick coupling. Compare bounded scoped order storage and property-based alternatives without asserting generic metadata already exists or is automatically smaller.
semantic_critical_checks: Recognize exact manual sequence needs stored user intent; existing due/priority sort alone does not solve it.
Reject implicit display-to-pick coupling.
Compare bounded scoped order storage and property-based alternatives without asserting generic metadata already exists or is automatically smaller.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Reparenting, duplicate/missing keys and deterministic ties.

F16.rationale: Prefer bounded child-view due sorting reusing existing comparison over plugin/expression machinery. Do not add persisted rank when due already carries requested meaning.
semantic_critical_checks: Prefer bounded child-view due sorting reusing existing comparison over plugin/expression machinery.
Do not add persisted rank when due already carries requested meaning.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Define missing dates and deterministic ties.

F17.rationale: Accept data-protection fix without default-off setting or two-workflow gate. Product acceptance must not claim all tests or concurrent/whole-board guarantees passed.
semantic_critical_checks: Accept data-protection fix without default-off setting or two-workflow gate.
Product acceptance must not claim all tests or concurrent/whole-board guarantees passed.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Appropriate failure-path and supported-platform verification before merge.

F18.rationale: Ask a focused meaning question that distinguishes sizing/aggregation, selection priority or manual ordering. Do not implement a weights field, invent requirements, or give unbounded 'research more' next step.
semantic_critical_checks: Ask a focused meaning question that distinguishes sizing/aggregation, selection priority or manual ordering.
Do not implement a weights field, invent requirements, or give unbounded 'research more' next step.
semantic_diagnostic_checks: Explain how meaning changes reuse/storage decision.
